name: dist_cons_cons
statement: α) (s t : Seq α) : dist (cons x s) (cons x t) = 2⁻¹ * dist s t

have_tree.name: h'
have_tree.type: cons x s ≠ cons x t

name: exists_fixed_point_of_contractible
statement: (β →ᵤ Seq α) → (β →ᵤ Seq α)) (h : LipschitzWith 2⁻¹ F) : ∃ f : β → Seq α, Function.IsFixedPt F f

name: FriendlyOperation.exists_fixed_point
statement: β → Option (α × γ × β)) (op : γ → Seq α → Seq α) [h : FriendlyOperationClass op] : ∃ f : β → Seq α, ∀ b : β, match F b with | none => f b = nil | some (a, c, b') => f b = Seq.cons a (op c (f b'))

name: gcorec
statement: β → Option (α × γ × β)) (op : γ → Seq α → Seq α) [FriendlyOperationClass op] : β → Seq α

name: gcorec_some
statement: β → Option (α × γ × β)} {op : γ → Seq α → Seq α} [FriendlyOperationClass op] {b : β} {a : α} {c : γ} {b' : β} (h : F b = some (a, c, b')) : gcorec F op b = Seq.cons a (op c (gcorec F op b'))
